intended_object: An auxiliary additive map that sends an element of the completed group algebra R⟦Γ⟧ = lim R[Γ/U] to the family of coefficient functions of all its projections, landing in ∏_U (Γ/U → R). The docstring and module documentation say it exists so the topology (and uniformity) of R⟦Γ⟧ can be defined by pulling back the product topology along it.
explanation: The definition is a technical device: it bundles all coefficients of all projections into one injective additive map, so that `TopologicalSpace.induced` and `UniformSpace.comap` along it give the topology and uniformity of the completed group algebra. It is then used for the embedding, closed-embedding and uniform-inducing lemmas. The literature has no named object that matches it; it is just the canonical map into the product. The construction is correct for its purpose: it maps x to U ↦ coeff(proj_U x), and additivity follows from the additivity of `proj` and `coeff`. It is stated at the generality of the library's completed group algebra, which needs a commutative ring R and a topological group Γ, so generality is not an issue.
